ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails and connections between recent fraud cases in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scandal and the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie.
questions: What are the financial connections between these cases?
How are perpetrators using Minnesota's systems to commit fraud?
ideas.insight: By following the money and analyzing financial data, we may be able to uncover patterns and connections between these cases that can inform future investigations and prevention efforts.
